• Pull-only adapters (no event-driven source API) still implement
subscribe() as a no-op -- it is part of the interface for every
adapter so the Runtime/Mapper can call it uniformly, but a
pull-only adapter never invokes on_update since read_field()
alone serves all of its fields. Not an error; expected and valid.
